reason: Jurnal - All Transaction (Zahir Insight): baris jurnal per transaksi, nilai mata uang dasar (debit/kredit) & mata uang akun (debit_a/kredit_a)
name: jurnal_all_trx
query:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT G1.* FROM (
    SELECT
      g.tanggal::date AS d,
      jv.account_id,
      k.code AS account_code,
      jv.department_id,
      jv.project_id,
      jv.cost_code_id,
      g.contact_id,
      g.currency_id,
      g.id  AS transaction_id,
      jv.id AS jurnal_id,
      g.type,
      g.nojurnal,
      g.keterangan,
      COALESCE(jv.debit, 0)::numeric    AS debit,
      COALESCE(jv.kredit, 0)::numeric   AS kredit,
      COALESCE(jv.debit_a, 0)::numeric  AS debit_a,
      COALESCE(jv.kredit_a, 0)::numeric AS kredit_a
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    JOIN kiraan k    ON k.id = jv.account_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
)
SELECT
  f.transaction_id                AS trx_id,
  f.jurnal_id,
  f.d                             AS tanggal,
  f.type                          AS tipe,
  f.nojurnal                      AS nomor,
  COALESCE(c.perusahaan, '')      AS kontak,
  COALESCE(f.keterangan, '')      AS deskripsi,
  k.code                          AS kode_akun,
  k.nama                          AS nama_akun,
  COALESCE(d.nama, '')            AS dept_nama,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(COALESCE(to_jsonb(d) ->> 'code', to_jsonb(d) ->> 'kode'), ''), '') AS dept_kode,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(COALESCE(to_jsonb(p) ->> 'code', to_jsonb(p) ->> 'kode', to_jsonb(p) ->> 'kodepekerjaan', to_jsonb(p) ->> 'nopekerjaan'), ''), p.namapekerjaan, '') AS proyek_kode,
  f.debit,
  f.kredit,
  f.debit_a,
  f.kredit_a
FROM f
JOIN kiraan k        ON k.id = f.account_id
LEFT JOIN cardfile c ON c.contact_id = f.contact_id
LEFT JOIN dept d     ON d.id = f.department_id
LEFT JOIN job p      ON p.project_id = f.project_id
ORDER BY f.d, f.nojurnal, f.transaction_id, f.jurnal_id {andOrder} {limit}
